parts.text: Please find, via the link below, an internship offer from LISN, University Paris-Saclay. This master’s thesis internship is planned to be followed by a PhD starting in October 2026, as part of the ANR IHU Sepsis project (formerly Prometheus).

Topic: Semantic Patient Profiling for Infectious Diseases Keywords: Knowledge graph, Generative AI, Argumentative reasoning, Knowledge embedding, Patient profiling, Infectious disease. Duration: Six months (full-time, 2026). Requirement. M2 student in Computer Science, Data/AI. Solid background in Knowledge Representation and Python/Java, autonomy, rigor, a good level of English, and teamwork.
